detected_fault: Frequent Crashes on Launch with Blue Screen of Death (BSOD)
suggested_solution: Collect and upload minidump files from C:\Windows\Minidump to facilitate further analysis.
Run a thorough system scan using tools like Malwarebytes or HitmanPro to detect and remove any malicious software.
Update drivers to the latest versions, including graphics, audio, and other components.
Perform a clean boot of Windows to isolate potential causes.
Consider running a stress test on the system's hardware components (e.g., CPU, GPU, RAM) to identify potential bottlenecks.
